reply.thought: Need to verify refunds completeness and then pay each customer net balance using net_balance tool; check orders/refunds lists and then record payouts per customer.

Since net_balance will reflect actual ledger, proceed to pay net balances per customer rather than requested refunds. No concrete inconsistency beyond missing refund, which is reflected in net_balance.
Need net balances for remaining customers (birch, cobalt) then record one payout per customer for their net cents.
Fetch net balance for cobalt then record payouts for acme, birch, cobalt.

Refunds applied by Alpha appear complete for orders present in refunds list (102,105); ledger net balances are available for all customers. Proceed to record one payout per customer using net_balance amounts.
